title: TEHRAN, Oct 26 - secretary of Iran’s Supreme National security Council Major General Rezaei: made remarks following the conclusion of the quadripartite meeting among Iran, Pakistan, Turkiye, and Saudi Arabia.
text:
TEHRAN, Oct 26 - secretary of Iran’s Supreme National security Council Major General Rezaei: made remarks following the conclusion of the quadripartite meeting among Iran, Pakistan, Turkiye, and Saudi Arabia."

"———"

"SOT1, Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran’s Supreme National security Council (Farsi) (00:00 - 00:30): “I feel that a new atmosphere has been formed in the region thanks to the resistance of the Iranian nation and the authority of the armed forces. I felt a very positive atmosphere in the dialogue between the gentlemen; all three believed that if our four countries unite, many of the region’s problems will be resolvable.”"

"SOT2, Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran’s Supreme National security Council (Farsi) (00:31 - 00:50): “We agreed that the method should be for the security of the region we live in to be endogenous, meaning it is achieved by the countries themselves, and we must prevent any kind of foreign interference in this region.”"

"SOT3, Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran’s Supreme National security Council (Farsi) (00:51 - 01:20): “These collaborations should have started much earlier; sometimes they were even discussed during meetings at Islamic conferences among Islamic countries, but appropriate practical steps consistent with the region’s conditions were not taken because foreign countries would intervene and prevent the creation of true unity.”"

"SOT4, Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran’s Supreme National security Council (Farsi) (01:21 - 01:51): “ I hope that, this trip marks the beginning of a real transformation and a real practical action among these four countries. Especially in these circumstances, where the Americans are making many threats and so on, this trip showed that these threats have not had a significant impact on the world; otherwise, a great country would come to Iran now and sit down to talk with us.”"

"SOT5, Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran’s Supreme National security Council (Farsi) (01:52 - 02:08): “We preferred not to issue any statement for the time being, but we will release a single news report that will demonstrate our unity; through that report, we will show our unity, and God willing, we will move toward advancing matters in an executive and real manner.”
